description: This file defines a SwiftUI View component named GlowingOpenClawIcon that displays an animated glowing icon with customizable size, glow intensity, and floating animation. It references application icon images and manages scene phase changes for animation control.

classes.name: GlowingOpenClawIcon
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that renders a glowing animated icon with customizable appearance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer for GlowingOpenClawIcon to set size, glow intensity, and floating enablement.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The computed property that constructs the view layout including glow effects and icon image.

methods.name: updateBreatheAnimation
methods.description: Private method to manage the breathing (pulsing) animation depending on scene activity and floating enabled status.
